name: Duolingo
summary: Gamified language-learning app built around short lessons.
description: Duolingo is a language-learning app that teaches through short, gamified lessons on mobile and the web. If the site is unreachable, check duolingo.com again later for current plans and pricing.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: The official Super page lists a Free plan and paid Super and Super Family plans, with a one-week trial. Euro prices are not printed on that page.

howToUse.title: Open Duolingo
howToUse.description: Go to Duolingo, the language-learning app, on mobile or on the web.

howToUse.title: Take a short lesson
howToUse.description: Work through short, gamified lessons. That is how the app teaches the language.

howToUse.title: Recheck prices later
howToUse.description: Once the site is back online, open duolingo.com/plans for current subscription prices.

features_fr: Application d'apprentissage des langues gamifiée construite autour de courtes leçons.
Duolingo est une application d'apprentissage des langues qui enseigne via des leçons courtes et ludiques sur mobile et sur le Web.
Si le site est inaccessible, consulte duolingo.com plus tard pour les forfaits et tarifs actuels.
